useAndMine.tooltip: Animates the item while the player holds down right mouse button then left mouse button while aiming at the ground.
useAndMineParticles.tooltip: Visually shows mining progress particles while the player is holding both mouse buttons.
blockHitting.tooltip: Animates the item while the player clicks both mouse buttons.
itemPositions.tooltip: Applies transformations to held items to place them in the same positions they were in 1.7.
secondLayerDamageTint.tooltip: Applies the damage tint to the second layer of entities. This means that the player's armor, spider eyes, and endermen eyes will be tinted.
smoothSneaking.tooltip: Smoothly interpolates the player's changing eye height as they sneak.
heartFlashing.tooltip: Stops the filled-in heart overlay from showing in the hotbar while taking damage.
show1_7_10.tooltip: Replaces the 1.8.9 version number with 1.7.10 within various facets of the game. This includes the debug menu, title screen, and display title!
debugInfo.tooltip: Use debug information found in the 1.7 debug menu.
alwaysShowCrosshair.tooltip: Always shows the crosshair. Replaces the debug menu axis indicator with the regular crosshair as it doesn't exist in 1.7.
debugTextSpacing.tooltip: Spaces the text in a manner that is identical to 1.7.
debugTextColorScheme.tooltip: Applies the mismatched color scheme of the 1.7 debug menu
thirdPersonSneaking.tooltip: Positions the player model to mimic it's position while sneaking in 1.7. Only viewable in third person mode.
allowMiningCancel.tooltip: Allows the player to "cancel" their mining progress by using an item.
damageColor.tooltip: Applies the old damage tint color. This color is possible by porting the 1.7 damage tint rendering!
stickRod: Replace Cast Fishing Rod Texture With Stick Texture
stickRod.tooltip: Replaces the cast fishing rod texture with the stick texture while in third person mode. Weirdly a feature in 1.7.
blockingArm: Third Person Sword Blocking Arm Position
blockingArm.tooltip: Positions the blocking arm in a manner that replicates 1.7.
fastItems.tooltip: Flattens dropped/hotbar items to appear 2D. This may increase performance just like it did in 1.7!
mirroredProjectiles.tooltip: Mirrors projectiles so that they face the correct direction! This is a bug in 1.8.
disableAlexModel.tooltip: Disables the alex skin model as it does not exist in vanilla 1.7!
disableSkinLayers: Disable Skin Layers Except Hat Layer
disableSkinLayers.tooltip: Disables all skin layers except the hat layer, as only the hat layer exists in 1.7!
flameOffset.tooltip: Offsets the flame (when set on fire) of the player. Only viewable on your player! This is a bug in 1.7.
disableTitles.tooltip: Disables in-game titles as they don't exist in 1.7.
oldItemPickup.tooltip: Offsets the item pickup animation to match 1.7.
oldPickupArm.tooltip: Fixes an incorrect rotation of the player arm whenever an item is picked up while viewed from the first person perspective. This is a bug in 1.8.
oldGlint.tooltip: Rotates and scales the enchantment glint's texture coordinates to match 1.7's glint rendering.
oldGuiGlint.tooltip: Renders the enchantment glint in the GUI in a manner that matches 1.7.
oldGlintColor.tooltip: Uses the 1.7 enchantment glint color scheme.
centeredSelectionMenus.tooltip: Centers selection menus such that they start from the middle of the screen. Affects the multiplayer, singleplayer, and modmenu screens!
tabDimensions.tooltip: Replicates the dimensions and behaviors of the player list menu. The boxes, width, and length mimic 1.7.
equipLogic.tooltip: Replicates the equip animation played by switching items within the player's inventory or hotbar.
oldDamageTick.tooltip: For some reason in 1.7, the damage animation (hurt tilt, damage tint, etc) are ahead slightly. This option replicates that behavior!
oldSwingVisual.tooltip: Visually swings the player's arm during during the miss penalty. In 1.7, the miss penalty does not affect combat, so this option sort of emulates that behavior but without touching combat.
oldSwingVisualParticles.tooltip: Visually shows particles (criticals, sharpness, etc) during missed hits given the appropriate conditions.
slowUpSneak.tooltip: Makes the sneaking up animation slower to match 1.7
stopLineTranslateSneak: Stop Fishing Rod Line Translation while Sneaking
stopLineTranslateSneak.tooltip: Stops the fishing rod's line from translating down while sneaking. Only viewable while in the third person perspective.
fixCameraPitch.tooltip: Fixes the camera pitch being incorrect while in the third person perspective. Affects projectiles, nametags, etc. This is a bug in 1.8!
oldPotionGlint: Only Render Glint On Potion Overlay
oldPotionGlint.tooltip: Only renders the enchantment glint on the overlay of the potion. This behavior only occurs for the item while it is held in 1.7.
replaceSkullModel.tooltip: Uses the old entity skull model and texture for skull items (not blocks). Toggling this will reload the game resources!
xpOrbPosition.tooltip: Offsets the XP orb's position. This is a bug in 1.7!
disableServerSelectionButtons.tooltip: Disables the server list selection buttons in the multiplayer menu as they don't exist in 1.7!
disableUnknownServerIcon.tooltip: Removes the unknown server icon in the multiplayer menu as it does not exist in 1.7.
disableSkinCustomizationButton.tooltip: Removes the skin customization settings page within the in-game settings as skin layers don't exist in 1.7. Intended to be paired with the "disableSkinLayers" feature.
oldMultiplayerSettingsPage.tooltip: Brings back the multiplayer settings page which replaces the chat settings page. Intended to be paired with the "disableSkinLayers" and "disableSkinCustomizationButton" features.
disableResourcePackItemTransformations.t: Stops resource packs from transforming item positions.
fixThirdPersonHeldItemSneakDeSync.toolti: Fixes a de-sync which occurs when sneaking and holding an item. Only viewable from the third person perspective. This is a bug in 1.8.
oldRodRotation.tooltip: Rotates the fishing rod in a manner that matches 1.7.
oldBowRotation.tooltip: Rotates the bow in a manner that replicates its exact position in 1.7.
swordBlockThirdPerson: Third Person Sword Item Blocking Position
swordBlockThirdPerson.tooltip: Gives the sword item the 1.7 sword-block transformations in third person mode.
useAndMineDestroyVisual: Use and Mine Block Destroy Progress
useAndMineDestroyVisual.tooltip: Visually shows block mining progress and plays block destroy audio while the player is holding both mouse buttons.
fastGrass.tooltip: Disables the grass side overlay. This was removed in 1.8. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
oldDoorTextures.tooltip: Reverts the textures of the oak door and iron door to their older counterparts. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
oldDifficultyButtonLogic.tooltip: Brings back the ability to change the difficulty of worlds from the main menu. This option also hides the difficulty lock button as it does not exist in 1.7!
moveSprintKeybind.tooltip: Moves the sprint keybind to the gameplay category within the controls menu which is the case in 1.7. This option requires a restart to show properly!
thirdPersonCapePosition.tooltip: While sneaking, the cape will be closer to the player which will clip through worn armor.
oldSpongeTexture.tooltip: Reverts the texture of the sponge to it's older counterpart. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
oldTallGrassTexture.tooltip: Reverts the textures of tall/double grass to their slightly darker and older counterpart! Toggling this will reload the game resources!
